get.summary: Whether Klaviyo is on, and how delivery is going
get.description: Delivery is best effort: an event Klaviyo did not take after two tries is counted here and logged, never retried through the outbox, because the outbox re-runs a whole event for every subscriber (D51). Klaviyo de-duplicates on the event id, so the retry that does happen is harmless.

sent.description: Events Klaviyo accepted since the store started.
